_meta.source: Draft behavioural-signal rules from DISCOVERY P2 (time to complete, skipped questions, one-word vs detailed open answers) and the 'signals' listed per archetype in archetypes.json. Thresholds and weights are guesses and must be tuned with Banfield once real submissions exist.

signals.durationSeconds: Time from the first question to submitting, in seconds.
signals.skippedCount: Number of optional questions left blank.
signals.avgTextLength: Average character count of answered open-text questions. Only applies when at least one open-text question was answered.

_meta.ops: lt = less than, lte = less than or equal, gt = greater than, gte = greater than or equal.
_meta.weights: Points added toward archetype ids, on the same scale as questions.json. A rule with no weights only adds its note to the team brief.
_meta.timing: durationSeconds rules are note-only until real completion times show that speed reflects client type (see docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/USER_RESEARCH.md). A test enforces this.
